insights.question: How many phases are included in the EV cold-weather testing plan at Elexion Automotive from Q4 2025 to Q4 2026?
insights.answer: The EV cold-weather testing plan at Elexion Automotive from Q4 2025 to Q4 2026 includes three phases. Phase A, scheduled for Q4 2025, focuses on conducting a gap audit and initiating pilot testing. Phase B, spanning Q1 to Q2 2026, aims to expand both laboratory and system-level tests. Phase C, planned for Q3 to Q4 2026, focuses on production validation and ongoing reliability monitoring, ensuring a comprehensive evaluation of EV performance in cold weather conditions.
